answer: Farming becomes an onyx bet on surviving 80 epochs of grading, and every bridge settlement recomputes the karst schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 80 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 38 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
